name: EMBL EIPOD-LinC Postdoctoral Fellowship (Exploring Life in Context)
amount: EMBL postdoctoral fellow salary (monthly, by duty site, with annual increases) + social security and benefits
other_rules: PhD held or defended by the call deadline
no more than 8 years of research experience since the PhD (career breaks and non-research time excluded)
prior work with the EMBL supervisor or partner lab no more than 12 months in the 3 years before the deadline
project co-supervised with a partner lab in an EMBL member state (3-12 month secondment)
notes: Interdisciplinary "life in context" projects across EMBL sites (Heidelberg, Hinxton, Grenoble, Hamburg, Barcelona, Rome). 2026 call: webinar 19 Nov 2026, opens 25 Nov 2026, closes 1 Feb 2027; interviews 8-9 Apr 2027; latest start 1 Sep 2027. 3-year contract, extendable to 5. References emailed to EIPOD-references@embl.de by the deadline.

documents.notes: Programme template with ethics self-assessment; page limit set in the template
